entries.description: Gain a psychic beast familiar that communicates telepathically within 120 feet.
Gain telepathy within 60 feet and advantage on saves against being frightened.
Summon an aberrant sentinel that detects invisible creatures within 30 ft. Official creature selection pending.
Your body partially decays; lose 5 maximum HP and gain an unsettling appearance. Until Remove Curse.
Gain a 1-minute aberrant dragon transformation with flight, psychic resistance, and a 4d8 psychic breath weapon (Dexterity save for half).
Psychic resistance and an elemental summon once per long rest.
Gain a gaze that frightens one creature within 30 feet on a failed Wisdom save for 1 minute (repeat save each turn).
Gain the ability to teleport 30 feet once per long rest, leaving behind an illusory duplicate until your next turn.
An aberrant fiend becomes aware of your existence and periodically sends servants to capture you. Until Remove Curse.
Once per long rest, grow an additional pair of spectral arms for 1 minute, granting advantage on Strength checks and grapples.
Gain a permanent shapeshifting ability: cast Alter Self without concentration once per long rest for 1 hour.
Summon a harmless-looking aberrant trickster familiar with telepathy and limited illusion magic.
Gain 60-foot darkvision, or extend existing darkvision by 30 feet, and detect nearby shapeshifters once per long rest.
Develop a monstrous mutation; disadvantage on Persuasion checks against unfamiliar humanoids. Until Remove Curse.
Once per long rest, squeeze through an opening as narrow as 1 inch for 1 minute, provided you carry no rigid equipment.
Gain a symbiotic tendril that can manipulate unattended objects within 10 feet.
Gain a 1-minute mind-flayer-like transformation with telepathy and a 4d8 psychic cone attack usable once per transformation.
Grow retractable psychic claws dealing 1d8 psychic damage instead of your normal unarmed-strike damage.
Aberrant roots invade your body; reduce walking speed by 5 feet. Until Remove Curse.
Summon an undead creature once per long rest; official stat block to be selected.
Once per long rest, become partially incorporeal until the end of your next turn, gaining resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
Summon a Dire Wolf once per long rest.
Mechanical animal familiar requiring no food or sleep; official stat block pending.
Gain the stench of death; disadvantage on Animal Handling checks, and ordinary animals are frightened of you. Until Remove Curse.
Gain a draconic beast transformation for 1 minute, with a flying speed of 40 feet, 2d6 claws, and resistance to one elemental damage type.
Summon an elemental creature once per long rest; official creature pending.
Gain a venomous bite dealing 1d6 piercing plus 1d6 poison damage, usable once per turn.
Gain a fey animal companion that can turn invisible once per long rest.
A hostile Hell Hound begins hunting you; the curse sustains its pursuit. Until Remove Curse.
Transform into a dire wolf once per long rest for 1 minute, retaining your mental ability scores.
Gain controlled beast shapeshifting: once per long rest, transform into a Beast of CR 1 or lower for up to 1 hour.
Summon a random harmless magical animal familiar, changing its form after each long rest.
Gain heightened predatory senses: advantage on Perception checks relying on hearing or smell.
Develop an animalistic deformity, imposing disadvantage on Deception checks to pass as an ordinary member of your species. Until Remove Curse.
Transform into a giant gelatinous beast for 1 minute, gaining acid resistance and an acid-coated natural attack.
Summon a plant creature once per long rest; official stat block pending.
Gain a spectral dire-wolf transformation with necrotic resistance, 2d6 claws, and a frightening howl.
Gain retractable 1d8 slashing claws and a climbing speed equal to your walking speed.
Your limbs become partially wooden; your walking speed is reduced by 5 feet. Until Remove Curse.
Summon an undead creature once per long rest; official stat block pending.
Shadow-hound familiar that can hide in dim light.
Summon a construct guardian once per long rest; official creature pending.
Gain the ability to cast Revivify once per long rest without expending a spell slot or material components.
Celestial judgment; -1 to Charisma saving throws until cured.
Summon an elemental once per long rest; official stat block pending.
Gain advantage on saves against petrification and immunity to the Poisoned condition for 1 minute once per long rest.
Gain a sprite familiar with celestial features and the ability to cast Light.
Gain resistance to fire or radiant damage (choose when the effect is received).
Assume the appearance of a radiant giant for 1 minute, gaining 10 temporary HP and 10-foot reach with melee attacks.
A celestial brand exposes your lies; you have disadvantage on Deception checks until the brand is removed. Until Remove Curse.
Gain a permanent celestial familiar that can cast Cure Wounds at 2nd level once per long rest.
Once per long rest, radiate moonlight for 1 minute; allies within 10 feet gain advantage on saves against being frightened.
Summon a Griffon once per long rest.
Your body rejects restorative magic; magical healing you receive is reduced by 2 HP per instance. Until Remove Curse.
Gain a healing blossom that restores 2d8 HP once per long rest.
Once per long rest, gain resistance to necrotic damage and immunity to being frightened for 1 minute.
Gain angelic wings for 1 minute once per long rest, with a flying speed of 60 feet and an extra 1d6 radiant damage once per turn.
Summon a tree spirit once per long rest; official creature pending.
Undead creatures instinctively sense your celestial presence within 60 feet, even when you are hidden. Until Remove Curse.
Gain a celestial ward once per long rest that grants resistance to necrotic and psychic damage for 1 minute.
Summon an undead or construct guardian once per long rest; official creature pending.
Clockwork dragon familiar; official creature pending.
Summon a CR 3 elemental once per long rest for 10 minutes; official creature pending.
Your skin becomes rigid and statue-like; reduce Dexterity saving throws by 1. Until Remove Curse.
Sprite familiar with invisibility once per long rest.
Summon an infernal guardian once per long rest; official creature pending.
Gain a 1-minute stone-golem-like transformation, granting 15 temporary HP and advantage on Strength checks.
Gain the ability to cast Disguise Self once per long rest, appearing as a construct or humanoid.
A mischievous clockwork parasite steals one of your attunement slots until destroyed or removed. Until Remove Curse.
Gain a 1-minute living-armor transformation with +2 AC, resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning damage, and immunity to being frightened.
Summon a Basilisk once per long rest; use its official stat block.
Gain an animated liquid-metal limb that can extend your reach by 5 feet once per turn.
Gain a mechanical vine familiar that can retrieve unattended objects within 30 feet.
Your bones turn brittle and metallic; reduce maximum HP by 5. Until Remove Curse.
Gain retractable metal claws dealing 1d8 slashing damage.
Summon an animated plant creature once per long rest; official creature pending.
Permanent undead companion using an official CR 1 creature stat block; reforms after a long rest if destroyed.
Once per long rest, phase your body for 1 round, allowing movement through creatures and objects as difficult terrain.
A draconic necromantic curse reduces your maximum HP by 10. Until Remove Curse.
Summon an elemental once per long rest; official creature pending.
Gain a deathly gaze that can impose the Poisoned condition on one creature for 1 minute after a failed Constitution save.
Gain a ghostly fey familiar that can become invisible.
Gain a 1-minute death-fiend transformation with resistance to fire and necrotic damage and a 2d8 necrotic melee attack.
Your body becomes unnaturally heavy; reduce walking speed by 10 feet. Until Remove Curse.
Once per long rest, appear as a deceased humanoid you have seen, as with Disguise Self.
Summon a skeletal jester familiar that can cast Minor Illusion.
Gain resistance to necrotic damage for 1 minute once per long rest.
Summon an undead creature once per long rest; official stat block pending.
Your flesh partially liquefies; lose 1 AC unless wearing medium or heavy armor. Until Remove Curse.
Gain regenerative fungal symbiosis: once per long rest, regenerate 5 HP at the start of each turn for 1 minute while above 0 HP.
Gain the ability to cast Speak with Dead once per long rest.
Gain skeletal claws dealing 1d8 necrotic damage instead of normal unarmed damage.
Summon a plant creature once per long rest; official creature pending.
You become vulnerable to radiant damage until the curse is removed.
Once per long rest, become ghostly for 1 minute, gaining resistance to necrotic damage and the ability to hover 10 feet above the ground.
Gain a 3d6 elemental breath weapon once per long rest, using a 15-foot cone.
Gain a 1-minute basilisk-dragon transformation with 2d6 claws and a gaze that restrains a creature on a failed Constitution save.
Gain a faerie dragon familiar capable of minor illusions.
Transform involuntarily into a tiefling with draconic features, replacing species traits until cured.
Gain a 1-minute draconic giant transformation with 10-foot reach and 15 temporary HP.
Gain the ability to grow scales for 1 minute, granting +1 AC.
Gain a miniature dragon familiar that changes its elemental affinity after each long rest.
Gain a 1-minute dragon-hybrid transformation: 40-foot flight, 2d6 claws, elemental resistance, and a 4d6 breath weapon usable once.
Involuntarily become dragonborn, replacing species traits until cured.
Gain acid resistance and the ability to spit acid for 2d8 damage once per long rest.
Summon a plant creature once per long rest; official creature pending.
Undead familiar with a frightening effect; official creature pending.
Gain retractable draconic claws dealing 1d10 slashing damage instead of normal unarmed damage.
Your body develops bark-like scales; you become vulnerable to fire damage until cured.
Summon a Wight once per long rest for 1 minute, using its official Monster Manual statistics.
Gain a 1-minute shadow-dragon aura, granting resistance to necrotic damage and 30-foot darkvision.
Gain a petrifying elemental touch that restrains one creature until the end of your next turn on a failed Constitution save.
Summon a small elemental or fey creature once per long rest; official creature pending.
Become vulnerable to one randomly determined elemental damage type. Until Remove Curse.
Gain a 1-minute elemental giant form with 10 temporary HP and 1d6 additional elemental damage once per turn.
Gain a 1-minute elemental-body transformation, with resistance to your chosen element and a 30-foot flying or burrowing speed.
Gain a tiny elemental familiar whose element changes randomly each morning.
Once per long rest, surround yourself with lunar frost for 1 minute, gaining cold resistance and dealing 1d6 cold damage to creatures that hit you in melee.
Your body becomes unstable; after each long rest, take 1d6 damage of a randomly determined elemental type. Until Remove Curse.
Gain an acidic elemental transformation for 1 minute, granting acid resistance and a 1d8 acid touch attack.
Summon a plant creature once per long rest; official creature pending.
Floating elemental familiar that emits light.
Gain elemental talons for 1 minute, dealing 2d6 damage of a chosen elemental type and granting resistance to that type.
Your body becomes brittle like crystal; reduce maximum HP by 5. Until Remove Curse.
Summon an undead creature once per long rest; official creature pending.
Gain a 1-minute void-elemental transformation with resistance to force damage and a hovering speed of 20 feet.
Communicate simple ideas to snakes and gain advantage on checks to influence them.
Gain a poisonous serpentine bite dealing 1d6 piercing plus 2d6 poison damage once per long rest.
Develop a serpent's lower body, reducing your walking speed by 10 feet until the curse is removed.
Gain a 1-minute medusa transformation with poison resistance and a gaze that restrains enemies, potentially petrifying one after two failed saves.
Gain a snake familiar capable of mimicking voices it has heard.
Gain a 1-minute serpent transformation with climbing speed and advantage on Stealth checks.
Summon a Basilisk once per long rest using its official stat block.
Your skin becomes slimy and scaly, imposing disadvantage on Persuasion checks against unfamiliar humanoids. Until Remove Curse.
Gain a venomous vine that can deliver a 2d6 poison attack once per long rest.
Gain a 1-minute death-medusa transformation with necrotic resistance and a gaze that can paralyze one creature until the end of its next turn.
Gain retractable venomous claws dealing 1d6 slashing plus 1d4 poison damage.
Summon a plant creature once per long rest; official creature pending.
Petrifying curse reduces Dexterity score by 2 points (a -1 modifier) until cured.
Gain a shadow-serpent familiar capable of becoming invisible in darkness.
Imp familiar with fey-themed appearance; use official Imp statistics.
Gain a 1-minute fey giant transformation with 10-foot reach and advantage on Charisma checks.
Cast Polymorph on yourself once per long rest, limited to Beast forms of CR 2 or lower.
Fey steals your voice; you cannot speak above a whisper until cured.
Moonlit fey form for 1 minute, with one 30-ft teleport during the transformation.
Summon a Displacer Beast once per long rest.
Shimmering ooze familiar that changes appearance; official creature pending.
Dryad companion once per long rest; use official Dryad statistics.
Fey curse prevents you from benefiting from magical sleep until cured.
Magical 1d8 claws and advantage on Acrobatics checks for 1 minute once per long rest.
Step into a tree and emerge from another within 60 ft, once per long rest.
Summon an undead creature once per long rest; official creature pending.
Shadow-fey familiar with 15-ft teleportation in dim light; official creature pending.
Infernal growth curse imposes -1 on Dexterity saving throws until cured.
Devilish form for 1 minute: fire resistance and +1d6 fire damage once per turn.
Permanent Imp familiar using official statistics; can become invisible and deliver touch spells, reforms after a long rest.
Hellhound form for 1 minute: fire resistance and 2d6 fiery bite.
Summon an infernal creature once per long rest; official creature pending.
Sulphurous corruption imposes radiant vulnerability until cured.
Infernal vine can grapple one creature within 10 ft once per long rest.
Floating infernal skull familiar that sheds dim red light; official creature pending.
Infernal claws dealing 1d8 slashing + 1d4 fire damage.
Infernal treant form for 1 minute: fire resistance, 10-ft reach, 15 temporary HP.
Devil's soul lien reduces maximum HP by 5 after each long rest until cured.
Cast Darkness once per long rest and see through the darkness created by that casting.
Become Large for 1 minute once per long rest, with advantage on Strength checks and saves.
Summon a small giant-related creature once per long rest; official creature pending.
Moon giant form for 1 minute: Large size and 15 temporary HP.
Awkwardly enlarged body imposes disadvantage on Stealth checks and makes old equipment difficult to use until cured.
Gelatinous giant form for 1 minute: 20 temporary HP, 10-ft reach, acid resistance.
Summon a giant carnivorous plant once per long rest; official creature pending.
Summon an Ogre Zombie once per long rest using official statistics.
Giant claws for 1 minute, dealing 2d6 slashing damage.
Dense wooden body reduces walking speed by 10 ft until cured.
Skeletal giant form for 1 minute: 15 temporary HP and necrotic resistance.
Shadow giant form for 1 minute: 10-ft reach, necrotic resistance, and 30-ft teleport between areas of dim light.
Cast Disguise Self once per long rest.
Wolf-like humanoid form for 1 minute, with advantage on Intimidation checks.
Involuntary transformation into a monstrous humanoid species, replacing species traits until cured.
Amorphous body for 1 minute: advantage on checks to escape grapples and restraints.
Plant humanoid form for 1 minute: poison resistance and 10 temporary HP.
Deathless form for 1 minute: necrotic resistance, immunity to fear, 10 temporary HP.
Retractable 1d8 claws and advantage on Intimidation checks while displayed.
Bark-like skin imposes fire vulnerability until cured.
Appear undead and evade detection by unintelligent undead for 1 minute once per long rest.
Cast Invisibility on yourself once per long rest.
Transform into a random harmless Beast for 10 minutes once per long rest, retaining mental ability scores.
Summon a random CR 1 or lower Monstrosity once per long rest using official statistics.
Gelatinous instability imposes disadvantage on Dexterity checks for 1 hour after each long rest until cured.
Magical plant familiar with Entangle and Goodberry, each once per long rest; official creature selection pending.
Skeletal trickster familiar capable of Minor Illusion; official creature pending.
Magical 1d8 claws dealing a randomly determined elemental damage type.
Transform into an Awakened Shrub for 10 minutes once per long rest.
Mischievous ghost follows you and sometimes reveals your location to enemies until cured.
Teleport 30 ft to a randomly selected unoccupied space you can see within range, once per long rest.

Blessing of the Moon: Werewolf transformation as a bonus action, lasting 1 minute once per long rest. Unarmed strikes deal 2d6 slashing damage; regain HP at the start of each turn equal to half your level (rounded down) + proficiency bonus. Regeneration stops at 0 HP and is suppressed by silvered-weapon damage since your previous turn. No advantage on melee attacks.
Moonlit ooze form for 1 minute: squeeze through tiny openings and gain acid resistance.
Lunar flowers restore 2d8 HP to a touched creature once per long rest.

Curse of the Moon: Once per long rest, when dropping below half HP, make a DC 13 Wisdom save or partially transform for 1 minute. Disadvantage on Wisdom and Charisma checks, cannot receive magical healing, and take +1d6 damage from silvered weapons. Retain control of your actions. Ends with Remove Curse.
Gain magical silvered claws dealing 1d10 damage for 1 minute once per long rest.
Moonlit treant form for 1 minute: 10 temporary HP and 10-ft reach.
Spectral werewolf form for 1 minute: necrotic resistance, 2d6 claws, and frightening howl.
Become invisible in dim light or darkness until the end of your next turn once per long rest.
Monstrous growths reduce maximum HP by 5 and impose disadvantage on checks to escape grapples until cured.
Summon a Shambling Mound once per long rest, using official statistics.
Summon an undead creature once per long rest; official creature pending.
Monstrous claws dealing 1d10 slashing damage and climbing speed equal to walking speed.
Monstrous treant form for 1 minute: 20 temporary HP, 10-ft reach, and ability to restrain one creature with roots.
Ghoul-like hunger; after a long rest without consuming fresh meat, gain 1 Exhaustion level until the curse is removed.
Summon a shadow creature once per long rest; official creature pending.
Plant or ooze familiar with a restraining ability; official creature pending.
Ooze familiar capable of dissolving small unattended nonmagical objects; official creature pending.
Acidic claws dealing 1d8 acid damage instead of normal unarmed damage.
Sticky skin imposes disadvantage on Sleight of Hand checks and checks to escape restraints until cured.
Undead ooze form for 1 minute: acid and necrotic resistance, 3 HP regeneration per turn while above 0 HP, and ability to squeeze through narrow spaces.
Shadow ooze form for 1 minute: necrotic resistance and advantage on checks to escape grapples.
Summon an undead creature once per long rest; official creature pending.
Thorn claws dealing 1d8 piercing damage and ability to restrain a creature once per long rest.
Roots grow from your feet, reducing walking speed by 10 ft until cured.
Fungal regeneration restores 2d8 HP as a bonus action once per long rest.
Shadow-vine familiar that hides in darkness and manipulates unattended objects within 10 ft; official creature pending.
Skeletal predator form for 1 minute: 2d6 necrotic claws, necrotic resistance, advantage on melee attacks.
Summon an undead or plant creature once per long rest; official creature pending.
Powerful undead creature marks you as its quarry and pursues you through servants until the curse is removed.
Spectral familiar with invisibility and telepathy; official creature pending.
Wooden claws dealing 1d8 piercing damage and climbing speed equal to walking speed.
Spectral claws dealing 1d8 necrotic damage instead of normal unarmed damage.
Shadow predator form for 1 minute: 2d6 magical claws, 30-ft bonus-action teleport once per turn, and necrotic resistance.
Flesh turns into dead wood; maximum HP reduced by 10 until cured.
Shadow treant form for 1 minute: 10 temporary HP, 10-ft reach, necrotic resistance.
Ghost form for 1 minute: 30-ft flying speed (hover), necrotic resistance, and ability to move through creatures as difficult terrain.
